text_block_list.text: The day of the Yasuda Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ever since her debut, she has claimed 
numerous victories in the sprint and mile 
divisions—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Here is the up-and-coming miler whose 
recent growth has been particularly 
remarkable, Taiki Shuttle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I make a formal declaration of war!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Objective: Defeat Hishi Akebono!
(Murmur...!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been watching Akebono's races for 
ages! She's so super big, powerful, and 
happy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Sort of a little bit? She's like me, but 
she also has a power that only Akebono 
has――

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So if we could run together, it'd 
definitely be super exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I trained sooo much so that I could run at 
full power right alongside Akebono!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'll fight with everything I've got today, 
and victory will be mine!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome! I wonder what'll happen! 
Taiki Shuttle is pretty big for an 
Umamusume too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Today's race looks like it'll be quite a 
spectacle~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Ooooh~! So that was the case, Taiki-san~.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Whoa, somehow, somehow...!

"The Yasuda Kinen is already a grand stage 
in its own right. Making a declaration of 
war in the middle of it might have made 
her understandably nervous."

As her trainer, should I ease her tension 
here? I clear my throat once from the 
stands.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Now I'm getting excited~! This is gonna be 
a super fun race~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
...Hm? Huh? Sorry, sorry, Trainer. Did you 
say something~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
? I see, maybe it was just my 
imagination~?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"—Well, I've got to go! See you again 
later~!"

Hishi Akebono is strong. With steady, 
resolute steps, she headed toward the 
Yasuda Kinen.
